messages:
sam: POC stuck - Acme can SSO but Dedicated role isn't appearing and Hosted API key wasn't auto-created. They say RDW-ACME-admin is assigned in Okta.

leah-sales: Which flow? SCIM Group Push or SAML group claims?

sam: They enabled provisioning + SAML. Okta shows user in the RDW group but our console has the group with zero members.

max-ids: Quick test: curl the SCIM /Users?filter for the email and check for a \"groups\" array. If missing, Okta pushed the Group resource but not members.

okta-bot: Provisioning event: 2024-10-02T12:02:01Z GRP_PUSH app=RDW-ACME group=RDW-ACME-admin status=200 members=0

max-ids: Common causes: Push Groups filter, nested groups, or insufficient SCIM scopes (GroupMember.ReadWrite). Ask them to run a manual Push (App > Provisioning > Push Groups) and watch Okta logs.

nora-cs: Security: we can't create API keys for customers without an approver email. We can do a temporary ops backfill to attach the member server-side if they approve.

ops-bot: BACKFILL action queued: reconcile_group_membership tenant=acme-tenant user=jane@acme.com scheduled_by=max-ids at=2024-10-02T12:05:00Z

okta-bot: Provisioning event: 2024-10-02T12:06:12Z GRP_PUSH app=RDW-ACME group=RDW-ACME-admin status=200 members=1 payload_members=1

max-ids: Confirmed SCIM shows member now. Auto-provisioner ran at 12:10 and created Hosted API key label=\"acme-poc-temp-1\" for jane@acme.com. Please rotate/delete after the POC.

sam: I'll get written approval and confirm rotation. Also flagged note: for Private/VPC customers they may need a second SAML app with audience/ACS matching private console URL to avoid role mapping issues.

leah-sales: Thanks team. I'll add this to the POC checklist (Push Groups + SCIM scopes + approvals).
